text.description_html:
Laurey Kensington Cabinet Pull in Oil Rubbed Bronze

The Kensington Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull features a traditional design that is modern enough to be used in almost any home. Its refined style makes the Laurey Kensington Cabinet Hardware Collection a standard in home decorating. This Kensington Cabinet Pull has an Oil Rubbed Bronze finish. Choose from a variety of sizes.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Traditional Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Zinc and Steel
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Package with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available in 4 Sizes:

    LAU-86466:
    • C/C Length: 3-3/4"
    • Overall Length: 4-1/2"
    • Width: 5/8"
    • Projection: 1-3/4"

    LAU-86566:
    • C/C Length: 5"
    • Total Length: 5-3/4"
    • Width: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-13/20"

    LAU-86666:
    • C/C Length: 7-1/2"
    • Total Length: 8-1/4"
    • Width: 5/8"
    • Projection: 1-3/4"

    LAU-86766:
    • C/C Length: 10"
    • Total Length: 10-3/4"
    • Width: 5/8"
    • Projection: 1-3/4"
